name: Noida Toll Bridge Company Limited
summary: The company that built and runs the DND Flyway between Delhi and Noida — a toll road that no longer charges toll.
ownership: Promoted by IL&FS with the Noida Authority
about: NTBCL was formed in 1996 to build the Delhi–Noida Direct Flyway, one of India's earliest privately financed roads, and it opened in 2001. The deal let the company collect toll until it had recovered its cost plus an assured return — an arrangement that grew controversial as the years passed and the toll kept running. In 2016 the Allahabad High Court ordered the tolling stopped, holding that users had already paid more than enough, and the Supreme Court upheld that decision in December 2024. The company still maintains the bridge, but drivers cross it free.
facts: Built the DND Flyway, which opened in 2001 as one of India's first privately funded roads.
Toll collection was stopped by court order in 2016 and the ban was upheld in 2024.
The bridge is free to use today, though the company still maintains it.
